'''Virtual Block 9''' is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion from the late pre-reset period. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

Virtual Set 9.1 ''Republic at War'' was released '''10 January 2014''' and legal immediately (primary PC post).<ref name="vb91">https://web.archive.org/web/20140115143606/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/</ref> Virtual Set 9.2 day remains '''unverified'''. The hub Date banner keeps the honest range '''2013–2014''' (Legacy Virtual Blocks era ending with the October 2014 V-Card reset).<ref name="vb9era">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/</ref> Do not confuse with modern Virtual Set 9 (2018).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.
